## Verification — the blast-radius union

`packages/react/ packages/plugin-detail/ packages/app-shell/ packages/components/ packages/fields/ examples/schema-catalog/ apps/console/`, one repo-root `vitest run` through the shared verify lock:

```
Test Files  1500 passed (1500)
     Tests  17882 passed | 1 skipped (17883)
  Duration  1760.38s
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 1763s (29m23s)
```

The 1 skip is pre-existing — this branch adds no `.skip` / `.todo` / `.only` (checked against the diff).

⚠️ **Honest caveat on the sha this cites.** That union started before the final commit `7f69d3eeb`, which removed two redundant casts in the memo-pin fixture; the edit landed about two minutes into a 29-minute run, so I cannot claim vitest read the post-edit bytes. Re-measured on the final tree, for the package that carries both pins:

```
$ git rev-parse --short HEAD
7f69d3eeb
$ pnpm exec vitest run packages/react/
Test Files  80 passed (80)
     Tests  951 passed (951)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```

### Everything else, on the final tree

| gate | spelling | result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| types | `turbo run type-check` over the five packages and their closures | **34 successful, 34 total** |
| changeset | `changeset:check` — the spelling that actually runs `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | green, `No changeset declares a major bump` |
| changeset presence | `check-changeset-presence.mjs` | green, 11 source files of 5 released packages, 1 changeset |
| bytes | `check:control-bytes` | green, 7477 tracked text files |
| deps | `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import` | green |
| governance | `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the 13 diff paths | **NOT GOVERNED** — ordinary review route |

### Lint — a full population, not a narrowing

`eslint . --no-inline-config --format json` over the whole tree: **4892 files, 95 errors, none of them in any file this branch touches** (79 files carry them, all pre-existing, rules like `react-hooks/purity` and `no-console`). Warnings on the touched files are all `no-explicit-any` on lines this branch does not modify. Type-aware linting is **off** in `eslint.config.js` (no `parserOptions.project`, no `projectService`), so a type-declaration change cannot move any untouched file's verdict.

### Not measured

CI convergence — left to the PM per the dispatch. No gate here is reported as green on the strength of a run that did not happen.
